name: belanja
description: Belanja - personal monthly expense management app. Test runner entry point (tests live under app/tests/).

scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:api: node tests/api/test-crud-8080.mjs && node tests/api/test-checklist-8080.mjs && node tests/api/test-payment-music-8080.mjs && node tests/api/test-monthly-8080.mjs && node tests/api/test-monthly-rules-8080.mjs && node tests/api/test-time-rules.cjs && node tests/api/test-dashboard-history-8080.mjs && node tests/api/test-dashboard-reopen-8080.mjs && node tests/api/test-month-ownership-8080.mjs && node tests/api/test-e2e.mjs

scripts.test:browser:navigation: docker run --rm --add-host host.docker.internal:host-gateway -e BASE_URL='http://host.docker.internal:8080' -v "$PWD/tests/browser:/app" -w /app mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.45.0-noble sh -c "PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1; test -d node_modules/playwright || npm install --no-audit --no-fund; node test-navigation.cjs"
